messages:
Marta: quick async checkin — what I did / blockers / today
Marta: did a pass on the gw routing policy refactor (PR #3521), added tests for weighted routing. found one edge case where default route loses headers when fallback occurs.
Kevin: noted. can you paste the failing request/resp headers?
Marta: repro snippet — looks like auth header gets dropped when we proxy to legacy-backend during cost-tier fallback
Marta: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.internal
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
X-Route-Id: customerA
```
legacy-backend sees no Authorization in some runs.
Sasha: hmm that sounds like the proxy strip issue we saw in beta. do you see it in staging only or locally too?
Marta: staging consistently, local flake when using long payloads. suspecting our `hop-by-hop` header cleanup in route middleware.
AJ: I'm on auth middleware this sprint. I can take a look after standup. pinging you in PR comments.
Marta: thanks — assigning to @AJ in the PR. also leaving a test-case in integration suite.
Lina: FYI I merged a small rate-limit tweak: changed burst window to 200ms for /v1/embed to reduce 429s. we should watch error budget in staging.
Kevin: thanks Lina — did you update the per-customer token meter? wondering if the change could affect reserved capacity.
Lina: yes updated meter config; sample config below:
```
{"route":"/v1/embed","burst_ms":200,"rate_per_min":600}
```
Lina: deployed to staging at 09:18, no regressions so far.
deploy-bot: deploy 2024-05-29T09:18:12Z to staging succeeded (build 5482) :white_check_mark:
AJ: quick question — are there any routing policy rollout canaries active for this change? I don't want the fallback header fix to suddenly hit prod without observation.
Marta: not yet. request to do canary for 10% of traffic to us-east with header-preserve flag on. I'll add rollout config in the PR.
Kevin: I'll add an alert on missing Authorization count > 5 per minute in observability — so we catch regressions fast.
Sasha: also, pinging infra: can we temporarily increase log sampling for proxy component so Marta can get full traces? @infra-team if available.
Marta: blockers: need infra to enable trace sampling and AJ to look at auth middleware.
Marta: today: finish PR comments, add canary rollout config, update integration test, and follow up on deploy-bot metrics.
AJ: taking the auth middleware task, will post updates in PR tonight.
Lina: monitoring the staging error budget, will report back in ~2h.
Kevin: once AJ roots the header issue, let's coordinate a quick smoke and then promote to prod canary.
Sasha: sounds good. cc @product-ops for awareness of rollout window.
Marta: thanks everyone — leaving this thread open for async updates. :slightly_smiling_face:
